assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service is medically necessary to ensure compliance with the payer's coverage requirement that advance approval be obtained.
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.91, I49.5.
